title: Monte Carlo FIRE Trajectory Simulator
description: Run 1,000+ market scenarios in your browser to find the true probability your retirement portfolio survives. Parametric Monte Carlo with Box-Muller sampling. Outputs a probability cone, success rate, and Sequence of Returns Risk overlay. Zero PII. Zero API. No sign-up.
